appDescription: A convoy travel app that shares participating vehicles' progress and helps drivers review common stop proposals.

function.name: SHOW_CONVOY_STATUS
function.description: Show the current convoy participants and their shared travel progress.

function.name: FIND_MEETING_PLACES
function.description: Find candidate shared stops using the convoy vehicles' recent locations and the selected place search source.

category.description: The category of shared stopping place.

function.name: REVIEW_CONVOY_PROPOSAL
function.description: Open the pending shared stop proposal for the driver to explicitly approve or decline on screen.
